name: dsh-process-kit
description: 通用单人开发流程框架：文件状态机 + Gate 必停 + 角色分离。自带 9 个角色 subagent、流程骨架文档、门禁脚本与 process_init / process_uninstall 工具。
author: SHADOW-LI0327

scripts.test: node test/host.test.mjs && node test/skill-registry.test.mjs && node test/scripts.test.mjs && node test/i18n.test.mjs

summary.zh: 通用单人开发流程框架（中文 / 英文双语）：文件状态机 + Gate 必停 + 角色分离。自带 9 个角色 subagent、双语流程骨架、门禁脚本与 process_init 初始化工具。
summary.en: A bilingual (zh / en) file-driven development-process framework for one person plus AI: file state machine, human-signed gates, and role separation. Bundles 9 role subagents, bilingual scaffolds, gate scripts, and the process_init bootstrapper.
